beats.text: In USA, global trade accounts for only 25% of economic output.
Sudan is the world's lowest, where trade equals just 2% of total output.
Trade is the sum of exports and imports of goods and services.
The largest economies trade less relative to their size. USA is 25%, and China is 38%.
Climbing higher: Pakistan has 27%, India has 46%, UK has 62%, Germany has 79%, and Mexico has 80%.
How much of your country's economic output comes from global trade?
